anchors.description: Vertical 3D distance from the front-right top edge of the striped seat cushion to the pavement at the foot of the chair's front-right leg (seat height of the striped terrace chair).
anchors.visible_evidence: A chair with a blue/white striped cushion and thin steel legs stands on the paved terrace in front of the slatted wall bench; its cushion front edge is clearly visible and its front legs reach the pavement, whose lit surface is visible directly below.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact chair model unknown; standard side/bistro chair seat height is 0.42-0.47 m and the cushion adds about 0.03 m, but the chair could also be a slightly lower garden chair.

anchors.description: 3D straight distance across the arched entrance opening between the left and right vertical jamb edges of the white curved wall (clear width of the doorway).
anchors.visible_evidence: A tall arched dark entrance opening (with interior stair treads) is cut into the white vertically-boarded cylindrical wall; both vertical jamb edges are clearly visible over a long stretch of wall, and the wall surface on each side is lit.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Clear width of a public-building stair entrance is not directly marked; Swiss public buildings typically use 0.9-1.1 m clear widths, and the strongly curved wall makes the exact jamb corner slightly uncertain.
